title: NDP 2026: Rehearsal Night Chaos
description: Rehearsal night. 40,000 phones open the app at once. Everything goes red.
storyContext: Combined rehearsal. 40,000 people open the app at once and every dashboard goes red. Fix it before the fireworks — or the committee kills the feature for the real show.

software-engineer.title: Emergency Fix
software-engineer.instruction: The app takes 8 seconds to load and people are giving up. One fix before fireworks. Pick.
software-engineer.hint: A quick fix now beats a perfect fix too late.

options.label: Add a [[cache]] — save recent answers instead of re-asking every time. Fixes 60% of the slowness; some info goes slightly stale.
options.consequence: Load time drops from 8 seconds to 3. A few fun facts are five minutes old. Nobody notices. 😮‍💨

options.label: Turn off the float scanner, show text only. Instant speed, but the star feature is gone tonight.
options.consequence: The app flies again — minus its star feature. The committee notices the missing scanner. Oof.

options.label: Fix the slowest searches at the root. Takes longer, but solves it forever.
options.consequence: You fix it properly... twenty minutes after the fireworks. Tomorrow's you says thanks. Tonight's crowd, less so.

options.label: Add a friendly waiting queue instead of error screens. Nobody gets kicked out, nobody gets instant results.
options.consequence: No more error screens — just a cute loading animation. The crowd waits. Patiently-ish.

data-scientist.title: How Many Machines Do We Need?
data-scientist.instruction: Each machine handles about 5,000 people. The graph shows thousands online at four check-ins. How many machines for the peak?
data-scientist.hint: Project the peak, divide by 5,000, round up.
data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: Machines spin up right as the crowd peaks. The dashboard fades from red to green. You exhale.
data-scientist.consequenceFail: Your estimate misses the peak — error screens for the overflow crowd. Capacity maths is brutal. Round up!

cloud-engineer.title: Find What's Broken
cloud-engineer.instruction: Every warning light is on. Order the investigation steps to find what's actually broken.
cloud-engineer.hint: Big picture first. Visible clues before hidden ones.

items.label: Pull up the live dashboard — what's under pressure?
Match the spike to specific parts of the app
Scan the last 10 minutes of error messages
Follow slow requests to see where time is lost
Tell the team what you found

cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: You find the choke point in minutes. The fix team moves before the drones even launch.
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: You dig into details before checking the dashboard — the answer was on screen the whole time. Classic.
